what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Ghana in the United States: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 5186 Ghanaian asylum seekers in the United States, 23.1% of all asylum seekers from Ghana.
Refugees from Ghana, a separate group, live mostly in Togo, Canada, the United States and Germany.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Ghana, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2023 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 278 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 5744, at the end of 2024, and was lower at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the United States.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for the United States only.
